Name: Jobab, Son of Shaharaim
Summary: Son of Shaharaim by Hodesh, head of his father's house.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:9: Son of Shaharaim by Hodesh, head of his father's house.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jobab stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
